limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the inverted RAM read enable but also changed the Gray-pointer pipeline, full and empty flag timing, and RAM access during reset, whereas the correct patch changes only the read-enable polarity.
The scoreboard used the DUT’s flags to decide which transfers to check, so it verified data ordering without checking whether the flags changed on the required cycles.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The cleanup trap caused the entire verification command to be rejected before simulation, forcing the agent to resubmit the test with different cleanup.
